P.name: We Are More
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Naafiri''' summons a ''Packmate'' that fights alongside her. She may have up to {{pp|2 to 5 for 4|1;9;12;15|formula=2 at level 1, then +1 at level 9, then +1 every 3 levels until 15}} ''Packmates'' at a time. '''Naafiri''' summons the maximum number of ''Packmates'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]].
P.description2: Hitting {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} with {{tip|abilities}} reduces the {{sti|cooldown}} by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 second.

Q.name: Darkin Daggers
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' hurls a dagger in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and inflicts them with a {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 5 seconds. The {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}} and non-epic {{tip|monsters}} if they would be damaged below {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|30 to 70 for 11}} health}}}}. ''Darkin Daggers'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds and within 4 seconds at no additional cost.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Initial Physical Damage|{{ap|35 to 55}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bleed Physical Damage per Tick|{{ap|35/10 to 135/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80/10}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Bleed Physical Damage|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|35+35 to 55+135}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20+80}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: If the dagger hits a target that is already {{as|bleeding|buzzword3}}, they are instead {{ccs|dealt|physical}} the remaining {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} damage plus {{as|'''additional bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}, with the '''base bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}} and the ''scaling'' for the '''bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 250 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2.5% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. If that target is also a {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, '''Naafiri''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself.

W.name: The Call of the Pack
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' goes on the hunt for the next {{tt|5 seconds|Hunt begins from the start of the cast time}}, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for the first 1 second and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} all of her active ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' in the first {{fd|0.9}} seconds. Her active ''Packmates'' will {{tip|blink|reappear}} near her after their vanish.
W.description2: After {{fd|1.25}} seconds into the hunt, '''Naafiri''' summons 2 additional ''Packmates'' that last for the remaining duration and can exceed ''{{ais|We Are More|Naafiri}}'' summon cap.
W.description3: While on the hunt, '''Naafiri''' gains {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and grants herself and all ''Packmates'' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
W.description4: ''Casting {{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}} extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration by {{fd|1.75}} seconds, up to its original duration.''
W.description5: '''''Naafiri''' can move during The Call of the Pack's cast time.''

E.name: Eviscerate
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
E.description2: ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' {{tip|vanish}} during the dash and {{tip|blink|reappear}} near '''Naafiri''' on her arrival. They are also {{tip|heal|healed}} to full health upon their reappearance.

R.name: Hounds' Pursuit
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' and her ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' {{tip|channel}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds to single out the target enemy champion, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in the duration. Upon completion of the channel, they {{tip|dash}} to the target; upon arrival '''Naafiri''' deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slows}} the target by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, whereas each ''Packmate'' deals {{ap|0.1*100}}% of that damage. ''Packmates'' become {{tip|untargetable}} during their channel and dash.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Physical Damage per ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|link=*none*|Packmate}}''|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b1}} to {{#var:rp_b3}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description2: If '''Naafiri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 7 seconds of cast, she triggers a pulse that grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|surrounding area|Can see through terrain}} for 1 second and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions within for 4 seconds. She can also recast ''Hounds' Pursuit'' once from triggering this effect within 12 seconds at no cost.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Naafiri''' immediately grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds before mimicking the {{tt|first cast's effects|Excluding the takedown effects, which can trigger only once}}.
